name: Nagumo
source:
Side character of episode 2
The chief of Sanze village.
A wise and gentle old man. He became [url=/c92657]Kirina[/url]'s caretaker after her mother's death.
Later on, Nagumo decided to leave the village in hope of finding a solution for the infection occurring in Sanze.
